title: Pisces: what to know
description: The essentials of Pisces in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Pisces: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Feb 19 - Mar 20. Water element, mutable quality, ruled by Neptune (and Jupiter in classical astrology).

pages.title: Sensitivity
pages.text: Pisces has imagination, empathy and an intuition that picks up what nobody said.

pages.title: Escape
pages.text: When the world feels heavy, they can retreat into dreams. Routine and limits keep feet on the ground.

pages.title: Romantic
pages.text: Loves with devotion, poetry and compassion. Needs tenderness and to feel understood.

pages.title: The one who inspires
pages.text: Does well in art, caregiving, music and fields where empathy and creativity count.
